title: fonts
summary: MSUI now resolves every confirmed active Fonts repair through the central registry and exact bake law. QuestTitleFont, QuestFont and MailTextFontNormal have exact configured pairs; ActionBar hotkeys use NumberFontNormalSmallGray in the frozen 36 by 10 right-aligned box; counts use NumberFontNormal at the exact bottom-right seat; and tooltip money uses NumberFontNormal through the shared measured row. Deterministic checks pass, while live font extraction, rendered Quest/Mail/ActionBar/money pixels and the preserved anti-aliased difference remain unverified.
